pypdfium2 5.11.0 and its fixed PDFium binary are redistributed only inside the
isolated document-rasterizer. The fixed wheel SHA-256 is recorded in
third_party/documents/sources.lock.json.

pypdfium2 is licensed under Apache-2.0 or BSD-3-Clause. PDFium and every bundled
binary dependency retain their own license. The component build copies the
wheel's complete dist-info/licenses directory, including BUILD_LICENSES, into
the generated bundle. This summary does not replace those license texts.

Upstream project: https://github.com/pypdfium2-team/pypdfium2
Binary source: https://github.com/pypdfium2-team/pypdfium2/releases
